from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')

path=base/'task-a18cae23.py'
source='''def transform(grid):\n    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])\n    colored = [(i, row[0]) for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0]\n    period = len(colored)\n    by_phase = {i % period: color for i, color in colored}\n    return [[by_phase[i % period]] * w for i in range(h)]\n'''
path.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_a18cae23', path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

demo2=[[7]*9,[0]*9,[8]*9,[9]*9,[6]*9,[5]*9,[0]*9,[4]*9,[0]*9]
out1=mod.transform(demo1); out2=mod.transform(demo2)
